snippet.title: Family BASIC Keyboard Commercial [1984, FC]
snippet.description: Commercial for the very cool Family BASIC keyboard and cart which allows users to create their own games using the a version of the BASIC programming language called HuSharp BASIC (since it was co-developed by Hudson Soft and Sharp).
